name: Battle-results tally fast-forward handler.
description: During the animated post-battle score and currency calculation, Cross fast-forwards the tally to its final values. The later result-menu proceed handler remains separate.
review_notes: Slot-2 replay and runtime-only binary search isolated BTL offset 0x00066210. Replacing only its Circle mask 0x20 with Cross mask 0x40 made Cross immediately complete the tally; Circle is retained by the corresponding UN5 routine and is treated as an upstream oversight.
